name: TwinCart Create Generic File Feed for Various Marketplaces
author: Twincart

sections.description:
TwinCart Create Generic File Feed for Various Marketplaces provides a straightforward way to generate and manage product feeds for external marketing channels.

Features

  • Ready-made templates for Google Shopping, Facebook Catalog, Skroutz, and Best Price.
  • Support for multiple file formats: XML, CSV, and JSON.
  • Automatic attribute mapping pre-filled for the selected template, with the ability to change which WooCommerce field maps to each one.
  • Automatic feed generation on a schedule (hourly, twice daily, or daily), or manually on demand.
  • Create multiple independent feeds, each with its own template, file type, and filename.

Want More? Go Pro!

Need finer control over your feeds? TwinCart Generic File Feed Pro adds:

  • Building a fully custom template from scratch.
  • Adding extra attributes to any feed, regardless of the template used.
  • Advanced product filters (stock status, product status, SKU list, categories) to control exactly which products are included.
  • Restricting a feed to registered users only, with per-user access control from each customer’s profile.

WC Compatibility

  • HPOS Compatible: Yes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/twincart-generic-file-feed directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Create your first feed under Product Feeds -> Add New.
  4. Choose a template, file type, and filename, review the attribute mapping, then set your desired Refresh Rate.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.

Can I choose which products are included in the feed?

In this version, all published products are included. Filtering by stock status, product status, SKU, or category is available in the Pro version.
sections.changelog:

  • Initial release.
  • Added automated XML/CSV/JSON feed generators.
  • Added ready-made templates for Google Shopping, Facebook Catalog, Skroutz, and Best Price.
  • Implemented manual and cron-based refresh functionality.
  • Declared compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
